notes: The sea off Arpoador, Ipanema beach's inside (what the aquarium was): one underwater scene in two states (start, full) and three looks (day, rain, night), with a 4-frame caustics overlay and a 4-frame rain overlay. Bases ship without stickers or the player. Replaces the simple first version in day1/ipanema/sea/ (left in place, unchanged).
role: workbook chapters fill it: sea fish and river and lake fish (the 'fish' family), beach life (the 'pond' family) and tank pieces (the 'aquarium' family); the rare-fish showcase holds the workbook-complete legendaries. Nothing is ever removed.

looks.night: after sunset in Rio until sunrise (rain at night shows night)
